_doc: Item catalogue. cat = weapon|ammo|attachment|medical|food|drink|clothing|backpack|tool|construction|technical|misc. Weapons are mirrored from weapons.json automatically. 'use' effects are applied by PlayerSurvival. 'equip' defines equipment slot and stats.

items.name: 9mm Rounds
items.desc: Common pistol and SMG cartridge.

items.name: .45 ACP Rounds
items.desc: Heavy, slow pistol round.

items.name: .357 Rounds
items.desc: Revolver cartridge.

items.name: 12ga Buckshot
items.desc: Nine-pellet buckshot shells.

items.name: 5.56mm Rounds
items.desc: Intermediate rifle cartridge.

items.name: 7.62mm Rounds
items.desc: Full-power rifle cartridge.

items.name: Reflex Sight
items.desc: Red-dot sight. Fast target acquisition.

items.name: 4x Scope
items.desc: Medium magnification optic.

items.name: 8x Scope
items.desc: High magnification marksman optic.

items.name: 9mm Suppressor
items.desc: Reduces report and muzzle flash. Not silent.

items.name: .45 Suppressor
items.desc: Reduces report of .45 pistols.

items.name: 5.56 Suppressor
items.desc: Rifle suppressor. Supersonic crack remains audible.

items.name: 7.62 Suppressor
items.desc: Heavy rifle suppressor.

items.name: Vertical Foregrip
items.desc: Reduces vertical and horizontal recoil.

items.name: Weapon Light
items.desc: Rail-mounted light. Toggle with T.

items.name: Pistol Light
items.desc: Compact pistol light. Toggle with T.

items.name: 45-Round 5.56 Magazine
items.desc: Extended rifle magazine.

items.name: 33-Round 9mm Magazine
items.desc: Extended 9mm magazine. Fits VK-9 and Kestrel.

items.name: Padded Folding Stock
items.desc: Improves recoil control on compact weapons.

items.name: Bandage
items.desc: Stops bleeding.

items.name: Improvised Bandage
items.desc: Torn cloth. Stops bleeding, slowly.

items.name: Field Medical Kit
items.desc: Restores health and treats wounds.

items.name: Painkillers
items.desc: Suppresses pain: removes limp and aim shake for 4 minutes.

items.name: Saline Bag
items.desc: Rehydrates and stabilises.

items.name: Canned Beans
items.desc: Filling and reliable.

items.name: Canned Meat
items.desc: Salted preserved meat.

items.name: Crackers
items.desc: Dry. Makes you thirsty.

items.name: Energy Bar
items.desc: Quick calories. Restores stamina.

items.name: Apple
items.desc: Fresh from the orchards.

items.name: Water Bottle
items.desc: Clean drinking water.

items.name: Soda Can
items.desc: Flat, but it's liquid.

items.name: Empty Bottle
items.desc: Fill it at a river or lake (look at water, press F).

items.name: Flashlight
items.desc: Handheld light. Equip in utility slot; toggle with T. Drains batteries.

items.name: Battery
items.desc: Recharges flashlights (used automatically).

items.name: Hammer
items.desc: Required for wooden construction.

items.name: Hand Saw
items.desc: Cuts logs into planks at a workbench.

items.name: Wrench
items.desc: Required for metal construction and vehicle repair.

items.name: Regional Map
items.desc: Read to mark the points of interest of the region you're standing in.

items.name: Field Cap
items.desc: Keeps the sun out of your eyes.

items.name: Combat Helmet
items.desc: Ballistic helmet with a night-vision mount. Reduces head damage by 45%.

items.name: Hoodie
items.desc: Warm, two pockets.

items.name: Field Jacket
items.desc: Insulated jacket with four pockets.

items.name: Raincoat
items.desc: Keeps you dry in rain.

items.name: Police Vest
items.desc: Soft armor. Reduces torso damage by 30%.

items.name: Plate Carrier
items.desc: Rifle plates. Reduces torso damage by 50%.

items.name: Day Pack
items.desc: +8 inventory slots.

items.name: Hiking Pack
items.desc: +14 inventory slots.

items.name: Assault Pack
items.desc: +20 inventory slots.

items.name: Cloth Scraps
items.desc: Rags. Craft into bandages or rope.

items.name: Wooden Planks
items.desc: Primary building material.

items.name: Log
items.desc: Saw into planks at a workbench.

items.name: Nails
items.desc: Box of nails.

items.name: Metal Sheet
items.desc: Used for reinforced structures.

items.name: Scrap Metal
items.desc: Salvage. Craft into sheets.

items.name: Bolts
items.desc: Fasteners for metal work.

items.name: Rope
items.desc: For ladders, towers and gates.

items.name: Concrete Mix
items.desc: Reinforcement material.

items.name: Empty Sandbags
items.desc: Fill to build sandbag walls.

items.name: Electronic Parts
items.desc: Circuit boards and wiring.

items.name: Mechanical Parts
items.desc: Springs, gears, bearings.

items.name: Spark Plug
items.desc: Vehicle part. Used in engine repair.

items.name: Car Battery
items.desc: Vehicle part. Used in engine repair.

items.name: Jerrycan (Fuel)
items.desc: 20 L of fuel. Use while looking at a vehicle.

items.name: Empty Jerrycan
items.desc: Fill at a fuel pump (press F at a pump).

items.name: Cigarettes
items.desc: Trade goods.

items.name: Wristwatch
items.desc: Valuable trade item.

items.name: Field Journal Page
items.desc: Notes left behind by someone who was here before.

items.name: Northwatch Codebook
items.desc: Signal authentication tables. Take it to the Old Communications Tower radio.

items.name: .50 BMG Rounds
items.desc: Huge anti-materiel cartridges for the Goliath.

items.name: Holographic Sight
items.desc: Wide window, clear reticle. Quick close-range aiming.

items.name: 2x Prism Scope
items.desc: Low magnification for mid-range shooting.

items.name: Muzzle Brake
items.desc: Cuts recoil hard, but it is loud.

items.name: Flash Hider
items.desc: Hides the muzzle flash at night.

items.name: Angled Foregrip
items.desc: Faster aiming, a little less recoil.

items.name: Folding Bipod
items.desc: Steadies long guns. Slower to raise.

items.name: Light-Laser Module
items.desc: Weapon light plus an aiming laser: tighter hip fire. Toggle light with T.

items.name: Pistol Laser-Light
items.desc: Compact light with a laser. Better hip fire.

items.name: 50-Round 9mm Drum
items.desc: Huge capacity, slow to reload. Fits Kestrel and Wasp.

items.name: 40-Round 7.62 Magazine
items.desc: Extended 7.62 magazine.

items.name: 35-Round .45 Magazine
items.desc: Extended .45 magazine. Fits Hornet and Harrow.

items.name: Precision Stock
items.desc: Adjustable cheek riser and padded butt.

items.name: Sling Bag
items.desc: +5 inventory slots. Stamina drain -2%.

items.name: Tactical Pack
items.desc: +24 inventory slots. Stamina drain +5%.

items.name: Expedition Frame Pack
items.desc: +32 inventory slots. The biggest bag in Vesper. Stamina drain +12%.

items.name: Chest Rig
items.desc: No armour, lots of pouches (+6 slots).

items.name: Light Plate Carrier
items.desc: Lightweight plates. Reduces torso damage by 40%. Stamina drain +6%.

items.name: Assault Vest
items.desc: Armoured vest with magazine pouches (+6 slots, 35%). Stamina drain +4%.

items.name: Heavy Plate Carrier
items.desc: Ceramic plates front, back and sides. Reduces torso damage by 65%. Stamina drain +15%.

items.name: Bump Helmet
items.desc: Light helmet with a night-vision mount. Reduces head damage by 20%.

items.name: Heavy Assault Helmet
items.desc: Thick ballistic shell with a night-vision mount. Reduces head damage by 62%. Stamina drain +3%.

items.name: Wool Beanie
items.desc: Warm.

items.name: NV-1 Night Vision
items.desc: Older night-vision goggles. Mount on a helmet (Inspect the helmet), toggle with V. Grainy. Uses batteries.

items.name: NV-3 Night Vision
items.desc: Military night vision. Mount on a helmet, toggle with V. Bright and clear. Uses batteries.

items.name: Frag Grenade
items.desc: Throw with Q (Shift+Q picks the grenade type). 3.5 s fuse.

items.name: Smoke Grenade
items.desc: Thick smoke for about 40 s. Nobody sees through it.

items.name: Stun Grenade
items.desc: Blinds and stuns everyone close by.

items.name: Fire Bottle
items.desc: Bursts into flames where it lands.

items.name: Demolition Charge
items.desc: Plant it (Use), then set it off with a Remote Detonator. Wrecks walls and doors.

items.name: Remote Detonator
items.desc: Sets off every demolition charge you planted.

items.name: Launch Site Key Card
items.desc: Red security pass. Opens the gate and the lift at the Launch Site, far south.

items.name: Vehicle Repair Kit
items.desc: Military field repair kit: restores 60% of a vehicle's condition in one go (use F at the vehicle).

items.name: Replacement Window
items.desc: Toughened glass cut to fit. With a wrench, refits one broken vehicle window (F at the vehicle).

items.name: Trail Runners
items.desc: Light running shoes. Stamina drain -12%. Wear in the feet slot.

items.name: Military Boots
items.desc: Broken-in combat boots. Stamina drain -5%, warmer and drier.

items.name: Work Boots
items.desc: Heavy steel-toe boots. Warm and waterproof, no stamina bonus.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.desc: Caffeine and sugar. Restores stamina; for 5 minutes sprinting costs 28% less and recovery is 30% faster.

items.name: Glucose Tablets
items.desc: Fast sugar. Restores stamina and gives a 2-minute stamina boost.

items.name: Military Electronics
items.desc: Hardened circuit modules. Sentry gun component. Found only at the bunker and the airfield.

items.name: Targeting System
items.desc: Optical tracker with a thermal sensor. Sentry gun component. Bunker and airfield only.

items.name: Fire-Control Board
items.desc: Weapon-mount controller. Sentry gun component. Bunker and airfield only.

items.name: Servo Assembly
items.desc: Traverse and elevation drives. Sentry gun component. Bunker and airfield only.

items.name: Power Unit
items.desc: Sealed military power pack. Sentry gun component. Bunker and airfield only.

items.name: Reinforced Mount
items.desc: Armoured pedestal for a weapon mount. Sentry gun component. Bunker and airfield only.

items.name: HE Rocket
items.desc: High-explosive rocket for the RL-7 launcher. Very rare.

items.name: Plastic Explosive
items.desc: Military explosive block. Crafting material for C4 and breaching charges (military workbench). Bunker, airfield and military stores only.

items.name: Breaching Charge
items.desc: Shaped charge: plant it on a door, gate or wall and it blows 10 s later. Small blast, very strong against doors and gates.

items.name: Military Toolkit
items.desc: Complete armourer's kit: counts as a wrench and a hammer, and repairs base pieces for half the materials.

items.name: Surgical Kit
items.desc: Trauma surgery set: closes every wound, restores most of your health and kills the pain.

items.name: Blood Bag
items.desc: Field transfusion. Restores a lot of health slowly — use when safe.

items.name: Ballistic Visor Helmet
items.desc: Heavy helmet with an armoured face shield. Reduces head damage by 70%. Night-vision mount. Stamina drain +4%.

items.name: EOD Armour Vest
items.desc: Bomb-disposal armour: torso and arms, 75% protection and half damage from explosions. Very heavy: stamina drain +22%.

items.name: Military Power Cell
items.desc: Lasts four times as long as an ordinary battery in night vision and lights (used first, automatically).

items.name: Field Radio
items.desc: Carry it to intercept raid traffic: warnings tell you the raid type, the size of the force and the direction it comes from.

items.name: Military Rations
items.desc: Complete ready meal. Very filling.

items.name: SUNSHINE
items.desc: Experimental illumination device from a sealed bunker vault. Activating it floods 100 m around you with blinding light for exactly one minute, then it burns out. Cannot be crafted. One of a kind.

items.name: Bunker 7 Key Card
items.desc: Level 3 clearance card from Bunker 7. Opens the restricted armoury on level B2.

items.name: Containment Log

use.note: Containment log, Bunker 7: "Prototype 3 went to full output for sixty seconds during the March test. Hollis is still blind. Command wants it sealed — no keys, no handles, the blast door welded from this side. If anyone finds this: it works once, and then it is slag."

items.desc: A clipboard page from the containment antechamber. Use to read.

items.name: Rotor Assembly
items.desc: Main rotor hub and blade grips. Helicopter repair part (install with F and a wrench).

items.name: Turbine Components
items.desc: Compressor blades, seals and igniters. Helicopter repair part.

items.name: Avionics Module
items.desc: Flight instruments and control computer. Helicopter repair part.

items.name: Fuel System Kit
items.desc: Pump, filters and lines. Helicopter repair part.
